description: BUG-09: `.../` in prose is a human's elision - 'some path under here, spelled short' - and is correctly unresolvable, so reporting it is noise. PATHISH now refuses a `...` segment, and refuses it whole: the trailing `domain/Signal.kt` fragment is not reported either, because half a placeholder would be worse than nothing. The genuine dangling reference on line 2 still is.
